notes: BANK STATEMENTS NOW READ PDF — BOTH KINDS. Most statements arrive as PDF, and 0.8.105 could not read them. Now a PDF with real text is read from its text layer, and a scanned or photographed statement is read by OCR ON YOUR OWN COMPUTER — nothing is sent anywhere — at a minute or two per page. Either way the rule stands: the statement own running balance is checked on every row before a line is accepted, and a file whose figures do not tie is refused at the first row that breaks, with both numbers shown. PROVEN ON THE REAL THING. Built against three real ADB statements for June, July and August 2026 — one text export and two scans — and every one ties from its printed opening balance to its printed closing balance inside the installed app. WHEN THE SCAN IS IMPERFECT. A scanner reads a 9 as a 0 more often than you would think. Where the rows after prove a single misread, the figure is corrected and LISTED FOR YOU, never silently. And a scan is read at more than one size when it must be: if the balances do not agree at the first, the pages are read again at a second and a third, and the reading whose balances agree is the one used. If none agrees the screen says so and shows the row where it breaks; correct the cell and check again. NOTHING LEAVES YOUR MACHINE. OCR runs inside the app with its language data bundled — no internet is needed and none is used. ALSO FIXED: THIS LEDGER CAME FROM ANOTHER COMPUTER. On a Mac this warning could appear on the same computer with the same books after a change of Wi-Fi, because the name compared changed with the network. It now compares the computer own name from System Settings, which does not wander, and it waits for the window instead of stopping the app behind a box nobody could see. A real move between computers is still reported exactly as before. NO DATA CHANGES. This installs straight over the previous version. Please still take a backup first: Backup & Export, Back up now.
